messages:
Priya: Quick note from the onboarding run: sampleapp parity failure between Node and Python on embeddings/rerank. Node SDK returned a wrapped envelope and different ordering which breaks our rerank helper.
Priya: Repro: run `node samples/onboard-embeds.js` vs `python samples/onboard_embeds.py` with same model 'redwood-embed-1024'.
Priya: Node payload parsed as: `{ data: [ { id: 0, embedding: [...1024] }, { id: 1, embedding: [...1024] } ] }`
Priya: Python payload parsed as: `{ embeddings: [ [...1024], [...1024] ] }`
Alex: ouch. our rerank helper expects flat list of vectors (no data[] wrapper) and also relies on stable index->id mapping.
Ken: adding to that, when token refresh happened in Node CI, I saw the SDK resend the unfinished batch but it dropped `x-client-batch-id` and `x-batch-checksum` headers. server accepted it as a new batch and we processed duplicates.
Lina: logs snippet:
```
Client: POST /v1/embeddings body.size=2 headers: x-client-batch-id=rb-2024-06-abc x-batch-checksum=sha1:123
Server: 200 OK -> responded envelope `data` in Node case
Client: token expired -> refresh -> retry POST missing x-client-batch-id header
Server: 200 OK -> processed as new batch
```
Lina: result: rerank got vectors twice, order changed, and downstream scoring mismatched.
Alex: possible causes: Node SDK response normalizer didn't map `data[].embedding` -> embeddings[]; the batching helper uses map/filter that assumes embeddings[] ordering; retry path doesn't copy custom headers.
Priya: impact: a few early customers on sampleapp saw weird score deltas and duplicate upserts in retriever index (low frequency but high pain).
Ken: short-term mitigation: add a defensive parser in the sampleapp (detect `data` wrapper and normalize to embeddings[]) and reject batches if checksum/header missing, surface clear error.
Alex: long-term: SDK should provide a canonical response accessor (`client.embeddings.unwrap(resp)`) across languages. and retry logic must copy idempotency headers.
Priya: filing quick fix PR for sampleapp + test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/412 (adds normalization + checksum guard).
Lina: opened runtime ticket to add server-side dedupe based on batch checksum even if header missing (audit path).
devex-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-1810 assigned to eng-runtime + sdk-team.
Ken: tests I'll add: cross-sdk parity test that asserts shape/field names + a network fault test that ensures headers survive an auth-refresh retry.
Alex: also check model aliasing while we're at it; but this looks mostly envelope+retry hdr bug, not model dim mismatch.
Priya: anyone hit similar with rerank API? noticed our rerank adapter silently reorders when ids present; adding stable sort by id in adapter PR.
Alex: thanks. will follow up on SDK copy-on-retry change. :thumbsup:
Priya: keeping thread pinned to onboarding ticket and sampleapp CI runs. if customers ping support, route to this thread.
